subject: eng
title: Review: numbers 1–20, colours, days of the week; to be / have got
goal: Ти повториш числа 1–20, кольори й дні тижня та навчишся казати, що в тебе є, за допомогою have got / has got.

theory.text: Сьогодні повторення: числа, кольори й дні тижня, які ти вже знаєш. А ще — нова корисна фраза **have got** (мати), якою розповідають, що в когось є.

items.ex: I have got a red bag.
She has got a blue pencil case.
He has got a yellow ball.
I have got a green bag.
She has got a black cat.
I have got a white T-shirt.
He has got an orange kite.
She has got a pink bag.
I have got a brown dog.

theory.title: have got / has got
theory.text: **I have got** (I've got) a bike. **You have got** (You've got) a dog. **He / she has got** (He's got / She's got) a cat. Заперечення: **haven't got** / **hasn't got**: I **haven't got** a cat. She **hasn't got** a dog.

lines.text: Hi, Olia! What colour is your bag?
My bag is purple. I have got a blue pencil case too.
I have got a green bag and ten pencils! I have got a small dog too.
I haven't got a dog, but I have got two cats.
Bye, Kate! See you on Monday!

theory.text: «Have got» означає «мати» — так часто кажуть у Британії: He has got a cat = He has a cat. Не забувай **has** (не have) після he/she/it!

exercises.q: Розстав дні тижня по порядку, починаючи з понеділка.
Встав have got, has got або haven't got.
exercises.text: I {have got} a red bag. She {has got} a black cat. They {haven't got} a dog.
exercises.hint: I/you/we/they → have got; he/she/it → has got.

exercises.q: Скільки днів у тижні? Напиши цифрою.
Прочитай діалог ще раз. Так чи ні?

items.text: Kate: "I have got a small dog too."
Olia: "I have got a dog too."

exercises.text: I have got a green bag. She has got a black cat. He hasn't got a dog.

homework.text: After Monday comes {Tuesday}. After Friday comes {Saturday}. The number after fourteen is {fifteen}.

homework.q: Напиши 4-5 речень англійською: яке твоє улюблене число, який твій улюблений колір і що в тебе є (have got).
homework.sample: My favourite number is seven. My favourite colour is blue. I have got a blue bike. I have got two books. I haven't got a cat.

homework.text: My favourite colour is green. I have got a dog. Today is Monday.

reflection: Які кольори та числа ти вже добре знав, а що довелося пригадати?
